description: Full profile for a tax-exempt org by EIN: legal identity, IRS classification and BMF filing requirements, latest extracted financial snapshot, and latest return metadata across extracted and PDF-only histories. Use nonprofit_search_organizations first to resolve a name to an EIN. latest_filing is the latest extracted snapshot; latest_return may be newer. Data lags 1–2 years; always cite the fiscal year. Data from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer and IRS Form 990 filings.

anyOf.description: EIN as integer (e.g., 530196605). Leading zeros are stripped — treat EIN as an integer key.
EIN as string, with or without hyphen (e.g., "53-0196605" or "530196605").

ein.description: Employer Identification Number. Accepts integer (530196605) or string with optional hyphen ("53-0196605"). Obtain from nonprofit_search_organizations results.

name: nonprofit_get_organization

address.description: Street address. Null when not on record.

affiliation.description: IRS BMF affiliation as <raw code> — <meaning>. Group affiliation alone does not prove inclusion in a group return. Null when not on record.

asset_amount.description: Most recent IRS BMF total assets in USD. Null when not on record.

bmf_tax_period.description: Tax period of the latest return recorded in the IRS Business Master File (e.g. "2025-06-01"). Often more recent than latest_filing.tax_prd_yr, which reflects the newest 990 ProPublica has extracted. Null when not on record.

city.description: City. Null when not on record.

deductible.description: Whether contributions to this org are tax-deductible, as "<IRS code> — <meaning>". Three states, not two: code 1 deductible, code 2 not deductible, code 4 deductible by treaty (foreign orgs). Null when the IRS Business Master File records no deductibility code.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `timeout`: A ProPublica API attempt expires before its response body finishes. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The complete ProPublica API retry exchange exceeds its deadline. `not_found`: The EIN does not correspond to a known organization in the Nonprofit Explorer database. `upstream_error`: ProPublica API returns a non-JSON body (HTML 500) or network error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exempt_status.description: IRS exemption status as "<IRS code> — <meaning>"; code 1 is an unconditional exemption. This records what the IRS granted, not whether the exemption is still in force — the Business Master File is a lagging snapshot and automatic revocations are published separately. Null when the Business Master File records no status code.

filing_count.description: Total filings with extracted data on record.

filing_count_pdf_only.description: Total PDF-only filings without extracted financial data. Use nonprofit_get_filings for their PDF links.

filing_requirement.description: IRS BMF filing requirement as <raw code> — <meaning>. Null when not on record; unknown codes retained.

foundation_type.description: IRS foundation classification as "<IRS code> — <meaning>", separating public charities (codes 10–25) from private foundations (codes 2–4). Codes 0 (all organizations except 501(c)(3)) and 9 (suspense) fall outside both groups. Null when the IRS Business Master File records no foundation code.

group_exemption_number.description: IRS BMF group exemption number. Zero means none assigned; null means not on record. Does not prove inclusion in a group return.

income_amount.description: Most recent IRS BMF total income in USD. Null when not on record.

net_assets.description: Net assets/fund balances (end of year) in USD. From totnetassetend (990), totnetassetsend (990-EZ), or tfundnworth (990-PF). Null when not extracted.

pdf_url.description: Source Form 990 PDF link. Null for some IRS processing batches — check filings via nonprofit_get_filings.

tax_prd_yr.description: Fiscal year of this filing (e.g., 2023). NOT the current year — data lags 1–2 years.

total_assets.description: Total assets (end of year) in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_expenses.description: Total expenses in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_liabilities.description: Total liabilities (end of year) in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_revenue.description: Total revenue in USD. Null when not extracted.

latest_filing.description: Latest extracted financial snapshot, which can predate PDF-only returns. Null if no filings_with_data are available.

form_type.description: Normalized known IRS form label, or unchanged unknown label. Null when absent.

pdf_url.description: Source return PDF link. Null when absent.

tax_prd.description: Full YYYYMM tax period of the newest recorded return. Null when absent.

tax_prd_yr.description: Fiscal year of the newest recorded return. Null when absent.

latest_return.description: Newest return across extracted and PDF-only histories, ordered by full tax period. Null when no history exists; equal-period entries imply no amendment precedence.

notice.description: Present only when both filing histories are empty. Describes dataset absence and BMF context without inferring its cause.

ntee_code.description: Full NTEE code (e.g., "E210" = hospital). Null when unclassified.

pf_filing_requirement.description: IRS BMF private-foundation filing requirement as <raw code> — <meaning>. Null when not on record.

propublica_url.description: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer URL for this org.

revenue_amount.description: Most recent IRS BMF total revenue in USD. Null when not on record.

ruling_date.description: ISO date of IRS recognition (e.g., "1946-07"). Null when not on record.

sort_name.description: IRS Business Master File secondary name line (SORT_NAME) — an internal sort key such as a division or service-center label, not an alternate organization name. Null for most orgs.

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation. Null when not on record.

subsection_code.description: 501(c) subsection number (e.g., 3 = charitable organization, covering both public charities and private foundations — see foundation_type to tell them apart). Null when not classified.

zipcode.description: ZIP code. Null when not on record.

title: Get Nonprofit Organization
